BoostText: Boost can be used to return your wolves from hunting early and receive tokens faster.

ClaimNftRewardsInfo: Here you can check and claim your NFT rewards.

CreatePlayerFirst: To play, you need to create a player profile.

InBattle: The wolf is already ready for the battle to start
LegendsRewards: Create your own legend! As the owner, you will receive an NFT with this legend. In addition, you will be rewarded after the release of short videos by Tago.
LegendsVideoShort: One wolf equals one legend equals one video short film by Tago.
LuckyStart: Choose your wolf. Choose any diamond. Add a boost if you want. If the diamond wins, your wolf will receive a prize in his wallet.

Season3Start: The third season starts on Tago's birthday.
ServicesDown: Sorry, some of our services are down right now.
ServicesDownInfo: If you're having trouble, try refreshing the page and checking back later.
ServiceTemporarilyUnavailable: This service is currently not available.

StatusText: The status gives your character value and opens up additional opportunities in various activities of the world.
StoreMinimum: We recommend having at least 5 NFTs in your store for optimal functionality.
StoreNftAddInfo1: Search and choose an NFT from your wallet. Input a price if you want users to be able to buy this NFT. Send the NFT to your PlayStore contract.
StoreNftAddInfo2: If the price is not specified, users can receive this NFT only by winning it in your store. To activate the Playstore, you must have at least three NFTs in it. The Playstore will be automatically deactivated if it has less than three NFTs. You can return your NFTs from the Playstore at any time.
TagoSlogan: For the strength of the Pack is the Wolf, and the strength of the Wolf is the Pack.

ValuationText: We recommend to exhibit this NFT exclusively at a price exceeding the specified one.

YourNFTText: You can see, sell, and buy all your NFTs right here.
YourWinsText: After participating in Tago events, you can see your wins here.
